Riverside Bicycle Club Saturday Casual Ride

Riverside, CA · Road

Beginner friendlyNo-drop

Riverside Bicycle Club Saturday Casual Ride is a road group ride in Riverside, CA. Schedule: Every Saturday (club also rides Tuesday, Thursday and Sunday); times on the club calendar. Pace: short, mostly flat, regroup in the middle; A/B/C/D groups on other days. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the start time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: short, mostly flat, regroup in the middle; A/B/C/D groups on other days. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Riverside Bicycle Club Saturday Casual Ride group ride

The oldest continuously running bike club west of the Mississippi puts on more than 400 rides a year, all open to the public. The club points beginners to the Saturday Casual Ride, a short flat loop with a regroup to socialize, and the Sunday D group. Start points are on the calendar.
